relations.name: Preserved Lemon Couscous
relations.rationale: The bright acidity of preserved lemon couscous complements the rich, chocolatey flavors of dark chocolate rye cookies, creating a well-rounded dessert pairing.

relations.name: Mojo Rojo
relations.rationale: The robust and spicy flavors of mojo rojo can enhance the dessert experience when served with the cookies, adding a unique twist.

relations.name: Original Mojo Verde from Tenerife
relations.rationale: The herby and zesty notes of mojo verde provide a refreshing contrast to the sweetness of dark chocolate rye cookies.
